paragraphs.text:
In the swirling snow you momentarily 
see a moving figure, though it didn’t 
remind you of Jeffries. The figure ran 
into the alley beside that strange domed building. It was heading 
south. 
To go south, go to 560; or to head east, go to 549.
(547, 549, 560)
